q.linePrev: It's clear to see, it's not them but me
q.lineNext: As I hide behind these books I read

partner.line: It's clear to see, it's not them but me

stanza: I sometimes have a tendency (Ooh, oh)
To look at you religiously (Baby, baby)
Nothing even matters to me (Nothing even matters)
Said it don't matter, baby, baby
Well, they cut off your hair and put a badge on your arm
Tell you to keep your mouth shut, boy, and get in the line
Wearing that Kim Jong-il hat, grandma’s selling pills
And meanwhile, I'm wearing my "can't pay my fucking bills" hat
